intro: The Simple Tablet is a written missive handed to novice troll warriors arriving in the Valley of Trials. Delivered by Gornek, it directs the fledgling combatant to present themselves to Frang, the local warrior trainer.

p: Within the harsh red bounds of the Valley of Trials, new recruits are quickly set to work. For young trolls seeking the path of the warrior, Gornek passes along this simple slate or parchment. Written by the troll Tar'sere and addressed to Frang, the master-at-arms resting near the Den, it serves as an official introduction to martial training in Durotar. It urges the recruit to step forward, present themselves, and prove their willingness to swing weapons under the banner of the Horde.
